title: Remove default host-level runtime paths from app and worker flows
description: Eliminate default host Docker socket access for main app and worker containers, and replace raw shell startup with a validated non-shell runtime command path.
action: In docker-compose.yml, remove the /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock mount from the main-service and celery-worker services; in backend/services/site_service.py, replace the ["sh", "-lc", start_command] path with a validator that rejects shell metacharacters such as ;, &&, ||, |, `, $(), >, and <, then executes the validated command through shlex.split(start_command); keep the default uvicorn startup path unchanged when start_command is empty.

criteria: docker-compose.yml does not contain "/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock" under main-service
docker-compose.yml does not contain "/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock" under celery-worker
convergence.definition_of_done: Key runtime paths no longer rely on host Docker privileges by default and no longer execute site start commands through a shell.

files.change: Remove the docker.sock bind mount from both default services.
Validate start_command, reject shell metacharacters, and run the validated argv via shlex.split() instead of sh -lc.
Add tests for invalid start_command rejection and for the non-shell startup path.

implementation: Delete the docker.sock bind mount from main-service and celery-worker in docker-compose.yml so host Docker access is not granted by default.
Introduce a start_command validator in site_service that rejects shell metacharacters ;, &&, ||, |, `, $(), >, and < at the API/runtime boundary.
Use shlex.split(start_command) for validated custom startup commands and keep the existing uvicorn argv path when start_command is absent.
Add pytest coverage that rejects dangerous shell-like start commands and accepts a simple argv-style command.

success_metrics: No default docker.sock mount for app/worker
Custom start_command uses argv execution instead of shell evaluation

reference.pattern: Safe path resolution and boundary validation in site_service

rationale.chosen_approach: Removing default host privileges and shell evaluation directly addresses the highest-isolation risks with minimal topology change.
decision_factors: docker.sock is mounted by default today
phase goal explicitly requires clearer isolation boundaries
rationale.tradeoffs: Some previously permissive shell-style start commands will be rejected and must be rewritten as argv-safe commands.

risks: Do not break the default uvicorn startup path for generated sites.
